# Dart and Flutter

- Platform-conditional code is a `<name>.dart` barrel that does `export '<name>_io.dart' if (dart.library.js_interop) '<name>_web.dart'` (see `cache/drivers/file_store.dart`), with a `_stub.dart` where native has nothing to do. Web code imports `package:web`, never `dart:html`, which the wasm build rejects.
- Construct a `MagicPerfEvent` only inside `if (MagicPerfHooks.sink != null)`. The guard is what keeps an app without `magic_devtools` from allocating one per attribute read or notification; a test holds `debugEventsConstructed` at zero to prove it.
- `lib/cli.dart` and `lib/src/cli/` run under plain Dart inside `dowel`, where `dart:ui` does not exist. Import nothing from the rest of `lib/src/` and no `package:flutter` or `package:magic` there; the one exception is `tinker_integration.dart`, which only `magic.dart` exports.
